name: representation-epoch-churn

protocol.note: Four catalog variants over the same linear RGBA8Unorm allocation and 8 standalone run_representation_transform attempts. (1) multi-version-unbounded leaves Arena::max_in_flight_representations at 0 and retains every newly created Private MTLTexture, so live_representations and the accumulated new_backing_bytes grow. (2) backpressure installs Arena::set_max_in_flight_representations(frames) for frames in {1,2,4,8}; transform() returns false with 'in-flight representation budget exceeded' once live_representations would exceed the budget -- fif==1 accepts 0 transforms because the allocation's initial representation already saturates the budget. (3) consume-input calls Arena::consume_representation after each successful transform with a complete ConsumeProof, so the allocation stays Active and live_representations stays near the transform window (<=2). Host bytes are restored after each consume so the next blit still has a linear source; that restore is test fixture, not a core API. (4) drop/quality is an application policy, not a core/Arena mechanism: on a backpressure reject the frame is skipped (no release_representation, no retry).

correctness.oracle: arithmetic: MultiVersionUnbounded peak at 8 transforms exceeds ConsumeInput peak over the same 8 attempts; Backpressure triggers at least once across the fif sweep; fif=1 Backpressure accepts 0 transforms; drop/quality skips at least one frame under a saturated budget
correctness.tolerance: exact (integer byte counts and reject counters)

judgement: Backpressure policy is an Arena-level max_in_flight_representations budget that makes transform() return false with an explicit error once live_representations would exceed the budget (catalog: 'unbounded version creation forbidden'; 'predictable failure rather than system thrashing'). ConsumeInput keeps the watermark near the transform window by releasing the superseded backing after each transform. drop/quality is the application-level choice to skip a frame once backpressure has refused a transform -- it is not a core API. Peak bytes are accounted from RepresentationTransformResult::{old,new}_backing_bytes on the host that runs the vertical slice; this definition does not record a fixture measurement.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024/030); no Vulkan-side RepresentationEpoch churn wiring was attempted (no Vulkan hardware reachable on this host)
